== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}

Mat surveys the battlefield through a horizontal [[Gateways|gateway]] made by the [[Shara]]n ''[[damane]]'' Mat captured, who took to being controlled by the ''[[sul'dam]]'' [[Catrona]] very easily. He has rescued the [[Aes Sedai]] from the trap [[Gareth Bryne|Bryne]] lay but at a loss of many men. The [[Seanchan]] are now using the term Aes Sedai instead of ''[[marath'damane]]'' under Mat's orders and [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag|Tuon]] has not countermanded it. Mat puts the camp on lockdown - no channeling - the Sharans are not cautious and may attack the camp in the night. Mat believes they should abandon this field and arranges for a meeting with [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] and the Sitters through a gateway.

[[Elmindreda Farshaw|Min]] interprets the omens for Tuon; Lord [[Gokhan]], who will marry, is sent to the front lines. A young female soldier has an image of a white boar and Tuon orders her execution, as this is the symbol of one of her rivals. After [[Selucia]] reminds Tuon that Min is her new [[Truthspeaker]], she tells her to speak freely. Min argues that her viewings may be used to warn of future events and people may be watched but not killed, until they are caught doing something and Tuon agrees.

A gateway opens with the Hall on the other side. Egwene confirms Bryne was under [[Compulsion]] and [[Saerin Asnobar|Saerin]] confirms all four Great Captains were targeted and that two-thirds of the [[Borderlander|Borderlanders]] were lost in battle as a result. Mat wants to make a unified stand and [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] is contacted through another gateway to approve this plan. Her battle is won, thanks to the [[Asha'man]]. The [[Field of Merrilor]] is the site agreed upon for their last stand. 

:{{pov|[[Galadedrid Damodred]]}}

Galad finds [[Trom]]'s body on the battlefield outside Cairhien. He continues up a hill to Elayne who is telling her leaders of Mat's new plan and urging them to call the battle a victory, despite their huge losses.
